description:
Position Summary:  
 Direct Supply is building the future of healthcare technology with industry-leading products, solutions and platforms to help improve the lives of millions of seniors and those who care for them. 

 In the Software Engineer position, you’ll leverage AI-powered development tools, machine learning models, and automation frameworks to build intelligent, adaptive, and scalable applications. This role focuses on both developing AI-enhanced solutions and rethinking software development with AI augmentation. You will work on a cross-functional team dedicated to creating high-quality, scalable web-based products, mobile applications, or server-based systems, ensuring real customer impact by balancing innovation with execution. 

 Skills Needed: 
 Systems Thinking & Problem Solving - Identify the right problems to solve by understanding the broader system – customers, stakeholders, processes, data, technology, and AI. Connect root causes, dependencies, tradeoffs, and upstream and downstream effects to develop practical, scalable solutions that improve the whole.
 Create & Shape Ideas - Generate, test, and develop new ideas into useful, high-quality solutions and experiences. Use creativity, curiosity, technology, and different perspectives to see around the corner, innovate and develop ideas into outcomes that create value and scale.
 Learn & Adapt - Continuously grow and adapt as technology, customer needs, roles, and work systems evolve. Stay curious, learn beyond your core specialty, experiment with new approaches, use AI to accelerate learning, and improve through feedback and setbacks.
 Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript (Node.js/React), C#, and MVC frameworks, ensuring efficient and scalable development. 
 Experience integrating AI capabilities such as natural language processing, computer vision, and generative models to create innovative solutions. 
 Ability to lead complex initiatives that push the boundaries of AI-driven software development. 
 
 What You’ll Do and Impact:  
 Develop AI-powered applications that enhance user experiences, including chatbot assistants, image-based diagnostics, and automation tools. 
 Build secure, scalable, and high-performance systems, leveraging AI-driven insights for continuous improvement. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineers to redefine customer journeys with Agentic AI solutions. 
 Design and implement APIs and microservices for seamless integration between applications and databases. 
 Establish monitoring, metrics, and reporting systems to ensure AI application observability and performance. 
 Prototype and iterate AI-driven features rapidly, ensuring adaptability in a fast-moving environment. 
 Stay ahead of AI advancements, integrating emerging technologies into development workflows. 
 Work in an agile environment, balancing priorities while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset. 
 
 Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 1-3 years of previous software engineering experience
 Proficiency in Python, JavaScript (Node.js/React), C#, and MVC frameworks. 
 Experience developing AI-powered applications, with examples showcasing AI integrations using open models (e.g., Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic). 
 Familiarity with Microsoft environments (Visual Studio, VS Code) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure). 
 Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies and version control systems (Git). 
 
 Additional Items of Interest: 
 Experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, AutoGPT). 
 Contributions to open-source AI projects or AI-first research initiatives. 
 Expertise in AI-powered UI/UX development for enhanced human-computer interaction. 
 Understanding of AI model cost implications, cloud infrastructure, and performance optimization. 
 Participation in AI-related communities, meetups, or speaking engagements. 
 Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration tools. 
 Job to be performed in the location listed. Generous benefit package available.
